answer: Neighborhood Cutoff Registration: each new agent must attach to a region whose existing members already hold a minimum count of mutually distinct inbound links. The delta between a fake cluster's internal link count and its external links is computed; clusters exceeding that delta are dropped. A shard of the region graph called a shale layer rejects joins when local connectivity falls below the crystal threshold. Each fake identity costs an attacker one real, independently reachable neighbor outside the cluster.
